name: How do you protect existing elements during post-remodel painting?

mainEntity.name: How do you protect existing elements during post-remodel painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protecting existing elements during post-remodel painting involves meticulous preparation to safeguard surfaces not being painted. This includes carefully covering floors with drop cloths, taping off trim, windows, and doors, and masking any built-in fixtures or appliances. For projects in areas like Berkeley or Oakland where existing features might be part of an older home, specialized attention is given to preserve historical details or delicate materials, ensuring no accidental paint transfer or damage occurs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Existing elements are protected by covering floors, taping trim, and masking fixtures, with special care for historical features in older homes.
